title: Custom Steel Fabrication in Pakistan | Steel Mind
description: Steel Mind fabricates machine frames, tanks, hoppers, doors, gates and stairs to your drawings. Custom steel work from one factory in Lahore.
h1: Custom Steel Fabrication in Pakistan: Steel Products Made to Your Drawing
quickAnswer: Custom steel fabrication means making a steel item to your own design and size. Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. fabricates machine frames, tanks, hoppers, doors, gates and stairs from your drawing or sketch.
alt: Custom steel machine frame being fabricated in the Steel Mind workshop in Lahore.

faq.q: What do I need to send for a quote?
faq.a: Send a drawing or a sketch with dimensions, the quantity and the place of use. Photos help but a drawing is better.

faq.q: Can Steel Mind copy an existing part?
faq.a: Yes. If you supply the part or a drawing, an engineer will measure it and prepare a drawing for your approval.

blocks.text: Custom fabrication is the making of a steel item to your own design. It is not a stock product. You provide a drawing or a clear sketch with dimensions, and Steel Mind fabricates the item in its Lahore factory.

items.name: Storage Tanks
items.text: Welded steel tanks for liquids and bulk goods.

items.name: Hoppers and Bins
items.text: For grain, feed and bulk material.

blocks.text: You send the drawing or sketch with dimensions and quantity. An engineer reviews it and asks questions. You receive a quote and a drawing for approval. The factory fabricates and paints the item. Steel Mind then delivers it and, if needed, installs it.

blocks.title: One Factory for Small and Large Jobs

blocks.text: The same factory that fabricates a building frame also makes single custom items. Both receive the same checks: material on arrival, dimensions after cutting and welds before painting.
